brief: JPM's afternoon note traces today's bond selloff to a hot September composite PMI (five-year high, hawkish surprise, worst input-cost inflation since 2020), which drove 2y/5y/10y/30y yields 12/16/14/9bp higher and pushed the 10y and 5y above the 5% technical level; a weak 5-year auction (3.20bp tail) added pressure. Iran's UNGA speech, offering conditional diplomacy (a claimed 7-day Strait reopening) alongside no improvement in Hormuz/Bab al-Mandab conditions, pushed Brent back above $100 (+4.6% to $103.59), compounding the yield move and dragging SPX -0.8%. Sinha reads the 10-year above 5% plus strong PMI as raising hawkish Fed risk and hedges Semis/AI with a lower-vol Earnings Vulnerability basket. Meta's Muse agent continues to dominate TMT desk commentary: disintermediation names (SHOP, EXPE, CART) fell further, SHOP gave back half a rally on Meta Pay for Muse rumors, and Insurify blocked the Muse agent from its marketplace. JPM stays Tactically Cautious/Neutral into the Fed, keeping +Tech vs -RTY, with lower oil/yields as the bull trigger and a consumer break or AI capex cut as the bear trigger. Separately, Joyce Chang flags a Democrat-favored House, a Senate toss-up, and rising populist AI backlash into the midterms.
